newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah remains weak in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah remains weak in quiet trading.

text.p: Indonesia's rupiah remained weak against the dollar in quiet late trading on Monday amid flush rupiah liquidity, dealers said.
"Trading volume was small as most overseas operators stayed on the sidelines due to a lack of fresh factors," one European bank dealer said.
Dealers said the thin trading volume amid flush liquidity since early trading kept sentiment on the local currency under pressure.
Tom/next managed to climb to 0.10/0.20 point from par/0.20 in early trading, but was still lower than an opening of 0.30/0.40 due to the flush market liquidity, dealers said.
They said the thin trading volume made it easier for operators to influence the movement of the overnight and tom/next swap rates to the extreme, either to the negative or positive side.
Overnight swap was last traded at -0.05/par compared with an opening of -0.1/0.10.
Spot rupiah was last quoted at 2,363.10/63.50 against an opening of 2,361.00/62.00.
Another dealer said the spot rupiah rate was likely to range between 2,363.00 and 2,364.00 on Tuesday.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were last quoted at 2,363.00/63.40 and 2,363.00/63.50 respectively.
Bank Indonesia kept its intervention band at 2,356/2,548 and the conversion band at 2,356/2,404 late on Monday.
